title: Digital Lending & Credit Scoring Platform
thesis: Snowflake consolidates applicant data into Dynamic Table 360 views, scores credit risk with ML.CLASSIFICATION replacing SageMaker, and provides end-to-end lending intelligence from application to disbursement

talking_points: ₱48 billion total lending portfolio — 285,000 active loans across personal, auto, and home.
NPL ratio: 3.8% overall (below 5% threshold) — but personal loans at 4.7%, approaching limit.
Average time-to-decision: 4.2 hours for digital applications vs 3 days for branch walk-ins.
show: Highlight personal loans NPL approaching threshold
tabs.call_out: Personal loans NPL at 4.7% — approaching 5% threshold

transition.line: Let's drill into what's driving delinquency and how to tighten decisioning.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION trained on 285K historical loans — KS statistic 0.48 (strong model).
Dynamic Table applicant 360: combines bureau + bank statements + employment in real-time.
AI_CLASSIFY categorizes bank statement transactions — reveals true disposable income.
show: Show model performance metrics (KS, AUC, Gini)
tabs.call_out: Bank statement analysis reveals true income — better than declared income by 23%

transition.line: Better data means better decisions. Let's look at the portfolio.

talking_points: Vintage analysis: Q1 2024 cohort performing worst — approval criteria too loose during campaign.
Collection priority model: top 500 accounts with highest recovery probability identified.
Digital applications: 68% approval rate, 2.1% default. Branch walk-ins: 54% approval, 4.8% default.
show: Compare digital vs branch channel performance
tabs.call_out: Digital channel: better approval rates AND lower defaults — invest more

transition.line: Let the Head of Lending ask the system directly.

talking_points: Victoria asks: 'What's driving the NPL increase in personal loans?'
Cortex Analyst: Q1 2024 vintage — approval criteria change allowed sub-₱15K income applicants.
Follow-up: 'Generate decision explanation for declined applicant X' — Cortex Complete produces transparency narrative.
show: Type: 'What is driving personal loan NPL increase?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + explainable AI decisions

talking_points: Multi-source data → Dynamic Tables (applicant 360) → ML.CLASSIFICATION → real-time decisions.
Replaces SageMaker + Glue + DynamoDB with native Snowflake ML + Dynamic Tables.
Philippine digital lending grew 45% in 2023. This platform processes 450K applications/year.
tabs.call_out: Applicant 360 + native ML — real-time credit decisions at scale

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine digital lending.
